input: unfiltered selected VGGT raw world_points plus existing COLMAP sparse points and measured tracks; no BA output or new inference

alignment.source: COLMAP to selected VGGT gauge: chordal mean of paired predicted camera rotations; closed-form positive scale and translation fit to paired camera centers; >=3 noncollinear common cameras

correspondence.pixel_rule: COLMAP observed xy minus 0.5, inverse common transform then original_to_model transform; nearest native grid pixel; no world NN or interpolation across sparse anchors
correspondence.collision: maximum classical weight then minimum sparse point ID

reliability.raw_support: number of OTHER predicted raw depths within 5% relative Z at actual point-head XYZ; not a correctness probability
reliability.scope: heuristic dimensionless weights, not calibrated probabilities; internal errors and correlated outputs remain possible

unknown: no qualifying correspondence -> exact original XYZ, no deletion or invented reliability
fit: maximize macro dev F1@2mm over three positive strengths; ties protocol order; audit raw and previous filter baselines separately; no default-enable unless dev beats raw

evaluation.inherit: configs/filtering/stage5_points_protocol.json evaluation; same 200000 original IDs and sampled GT; 1/2/5mm P/R/F1, means without distance trimming
evaluation.roi: recompute official mask at each evaluated XYZ after SAME raw-camera GT Sim3; report fixed pre-fusion ROI sensitivity too
evaluation.unweighted: same eligible correspondences, weight=0.5; only weighting ablation

runtime.resource_profile: reuse immutable raw and COLMAP outputs, native PyCOLMAP only for track export; no rerun or weights
